title: runstate's gitRun carries no maintenance pins, so its fixture git can start the detached maintenance tick qsn chased out of reconcile
description:
gitRun (internal/runstate/origin_test.go) builds its environment from os.Environ() with no gitbin.WithNoAutoMaintenance and no WithNoAutoMaintenance, so every commit, push and fetch it runs ends by potentially starting `git maintenance run --auto --detach` in t.TempDir repositories. On this host the read-only grade's GIT_CONFIG_COUNT pins mask it; on CI's unpinned git 2.55 (geometric, repacking from two loose objects) that is exactly the shape that made reconcile's t.TempDir RemoveAll fail with 'directory not empty' and cost two days (tick qsn) — reconcile fixed it by pinning the harness runner and added a trace2 guard, runstate's gitRun was left unpinned. A one-in-forty flake in the full suite on CI, outside this tick's host-side scope.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding 689837d26f781106253c93d88cd8d5027cd7cfb9f61d837cbb14fe9aa39e0bac (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-fc2/attempt-14): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates the done, naming no single item (the fallback names every item at risk in its reason). The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/689837d26f781106253c93d88cd8d5027cd7cfb9f61d837cbb14fe9aa39e0bac.json on the run branch.
